page_title: LIL 1-2 REI | Lille v Reims 26/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Eric Wattellier is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Referee Eric Wattellier halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Paulo Fonseca, then shows him a yellow.

90+4' Remy Cabella plays a lovely pass into Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
90+3' Alexsandro (Lille) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' William Still decides to make a substitution. Junya Ito will be replaced by Ibrahim Diakite (Reims).
88' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Thomas Foket walks off the pitch to be replaced by Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims).
87' Tiago Santos (Lille) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is behind the touchline and Lille will take a throw-in.

85' Jonathan David (Lille) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom right corner. His promising effort is kept out by Yehvann Diouf, who pulls off a stunning save!
84' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Eric Wattellier who sees an offensive foul.
82' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
79' 1 - 2 Ismaily produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Benjamin Andre (Lille) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:2.
79' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Edon Zhegrova (Lille).
77' A substitution has been made. Mohamed Daramy goes off and Amine Salama (Reims) comes on.
77' Here is a change. Keito Nakamura is going off and William Still gives the last tactical orders to Reda Khadra (Reims).
77' Substitution. Teddy Teuma will be replaced by Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims).
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lille comes to nothing.
76' The ball is out of play. Lille win a corner kick. Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
75' A quickly taken corner by Lille.

75' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
72' The free kick is delivered by Edon Zhegrova (Lille) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
72' Joseph Okumu (Reims) trips an opposition player and Eric Wattellier signals a foul. Lille have a free kick.

70' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Lucas Chevalier makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.

69' Remy Cabella (Lille) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
69' Neat passing move from Lille in order to create new attacking opportunities.

67' Jonathan David (Lille) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly over the bar. The goalkeeper was lucky! The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
65' Yellow card. Thomas Foket (Reims) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
64' It is time for a substitution. Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) is on for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
63' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Tiago Santos (Lille).
63' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lille.
62' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
60' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
58' Lille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

56' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
54' Teddy Teuma (Reims) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
53' Keito Nakamura (Reims) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
53' Keito Nakamura (Reims) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Lille are awarded the free kick.
53' Great teamplay by Lille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

51' Great solo effort by Edon Zhegrova (Lille) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Yehvann Diouf is alert and denies him.
51' Ismaily (Lille) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
49' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
46' Half-time substitution. Paulo Fonseca decided to make a change. Samuel Umtiti is replaced by Alexsandro (Lille).
46' The whistle blows and Eric Wattellier starts the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Reims are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
45+2' Tiago Santos (Lille) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Reims.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Lille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

42' Jonathan David (Lille) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
42' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lille are going to take it.

41' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
37' Samuel Umtiti (Lille) is able to continue to play.
34' Samuel Umtiti (Lille) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
33' Lille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
31' Yehvann Diouf (Reims) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. It's a throw-in for Lille.
29' Thibault De Smet (Reims) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
28' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lille.
25' Jonathan David (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' A dangerous looking corner kick from Teddy Teuma (Reims) is cleared to safety by the defence.
24' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Daramy (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Reims will have a chance to score from a corner.
23' The manager makes a subsitution with Edon Zhegrova (Lille) coming on for Yusuf Yazici.
22' Flag up against Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
21' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes.
16' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Marshall Munetsi tees up Keito Nakamura (Reims) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Lucas Chevalier.
14' Referee Eric Wattellier points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Mohamed Daramy (Reims) goes wild in celebration.
13' The Reims players halt their celebrations as referee Eric Wattellier makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
12' 0 - 1 Mohamed Daramy (Reims) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low in the middle of the goal.
12' Reims force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
11' Teddy Teuma (Reims) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence. The ball has crossed the sideline. Reims are taking a throw-in.
9' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) has a goal ruled out for offside!
8' The Reims players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

6' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Remy Cabella. It's a good effort but just misses the left post. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
2' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Reims will have the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier is introduced as the referee for today's match.
